evidence.observedFact: The business actively offers parties of all sizes and asks prospects to call or submit a form, after which the business says it will be in touch shortly.
The Mentor location is active seven days a week and publicly promotes parties, events, gift cards and carryout.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate a post-event guest capture and repeat-visit workflow that turns party attendees into measurable return customers.
Demonstrate immediate inquiry acknowledgement, structured follow-up and status tracking for party leads.

notes: Observed facts show an active event business and a call/form follow-up process. The opportunity to improve follow-up and event retention is a sales hypothesis; no monetary loss is claimed.
